Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 1 by misidentifying the director of the film "Gently My Songs Entreat." Upon seeing search results that listed both "Willi Forst" (director of the 1933 original) and "Anthony Asquith" (director of the 1934 British version), the Planner incorrectly applied a "first-listed-director heuristic" and concluded that "Anthony Asquith is treated as the director." This decision was flawed because the search results explicitly identified Willi Forst as the primary director of the film titled "Gently My Songs Entreat" (Leise flehen meine Lieder), while Anthony Asquith directed the alternate title "Unfinished Symphony." By prioritizing the British version's director over the original version's director without clarifying the user's intent or verifying the primary association, the Planner set the entire subsequent investigation on the wrong path, leading to redundant searches for Anthony Asquith's birthplace instead of focusing on the correct director, Willi Forst.
